scope: research Dxy video-measurement chain on the immutable SYNC4/S0 38-of-39 evaluation scope; this does not overwrite the separate historical result/ package
base_selector: result_sharp5(raw): one frozen raw candidate per bin, maximum existing sharpness; V2 validity is checked after the raw choice

geometry.M: full frozen INIT label-1 polyp mask
geometry.E: frozen current V2 final chosen circle/ellipse; no refit or size correction
geometry.U: dilated label-2 ring occlusion union fitted outer-minus-inner ring annulus
geometry.P: area(M intersect (E minus U)) / area(E minus U)

threshold_calibration.source: current-valid formal S0 original_V2_R0 views only; no GT
threshold_calibration.same_threshold_for: all ring sizes, Paris types, groups and captures

post_capture_rule.support_population: original raw-selected frames that are V2-valid and support-assessed
post_capture_rule.individual_repair_trigger: capture_trigger AND (C < C_threshold OR P < P_threshold)
post_capture_rule.replacement: first frozen V2-valid candidate in that bin, sorted by existing sharpness descending then frame_index ascending, satisfying C >= C_threshold AND P >= P_threshold
post_capture_rule.non_triggered_captures: retain the raw selected frame exactly, including raw V2-invalid selections

aggregation_and_fusion.B1: R_mm * median(L_px selected valid bins) / median(ring_px selected valid bins)
aggregation_and_fusion.capture_eligibility: at least 4 selected valid bins and p95(ring_px)/p5(ring_px)-1 >= 0.05
aggregation_and_fusion.formal_integration: replace only eligible video_keyframe capture rows; retain photo/S0 rows; group prediction is the median of formal current-valid rows
